blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has raided an online scam hub in Currimao, Ilocos Norte, that was disguised as an office of the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), arresting three Malaysian nationals who allegedly posed as American law enforcement authorities. According to the NBI, 11 Filipinos were rescued during the operation. They had been recruited as virtual assistants but were later forced to engage in online scamming activities. The NBI said operatives raided the facility in Barangay Victoria on Saturday, Nov. 14, after receiving a complaint from the partner of a female victim. The woman […]...
